newFindings.title: Repository published unpersisted state after failed writes
newFindings.rootCause: ToolbarRepository exposed candidate state before backing preferences write completed; callers could observe success-shaped UI after storage failure.
newFindings.fix: Repository persists candidate before publishing state. Confirmed SAF import uses Android SharedPreferences.commit() on Dispatchers.IO and fails visibly if the durable write reports failure; regular rapid toolbar edits retain apply().
newFindings.tests: Repository regression verifies import uses putDurably, failed durable write leaves published state unchanged; MarketDebug JVM suite 1,021/1,021 PASS.
newFindings.status: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_TESTED (unit verified; Android storage/UI runtime pending)

newFindings.title: Unbounded JSON parser nesting
newFindings.rootCause: Recursive JSON parsing had no nesting limit, allowing deeply nested imported JSON to risk StackOverflowError.
newFindings.fix: Reject container nesting beyond 64 levels with JsonException; import is separately limited to 1 MiB.
newFindings.tests: JsonTest depth-limit regression in 1,021-test MarketDebug JVM suite PASS.

newFindings.title: Bottom navigation labels announced twice by accessibility services
newFindings.rootCause: RootScreen copied each visible tab label into a parent contentDescription while NavigationBarItem already exposed the same label.
newFindings.fix: Removed redundant parent contentDescription; visible NavigationBarItem label and selection semantics remain.
newFindings.tests: MarketDebug compile, AndroidTest Kotlin compile, lint and APK assembly PASS; CI run 38396679291 Verify PASS, instrumentation in progress.

newFindings.title: Corrupt-config recovery notice remained after a successful repair save
newFindings.rootCause: ToolbarRepository retained the previous recoveryNotice and recoverableRaw values after later writes replaced the unreadable configuration.
newFindings.fix: Clear recovery metadata after each successful repository commit; failed writes preserve the recovery evidence.
newFindings.tests: Corrupt stored document regression now asserts successful save clears notice/raw; MarketDebug JVM suite 1,021/1,021 PASS.

newFindings.title: Host-specific toolbar profile overrides had no user-facing configuration path
newFindings.rootCause: ToolbarRepository persisted hostOverrides and TerminalScreen honored them, but only import/API callers could create or remove overrides.
newFindings.fix: Added localized apply/clear controls to the editor when launched from an active SSH session. Assignment is host-scoped and does not modify the global active profile; controls are disabled while the profile draft is dirty. Added API26/36/37 instrumentation coverage and expanded editor button touch bounds.
newFindings.tests: Existing repository precedence/clear test strengthened to assert global selection is unchanged; new end-to-end instrumentation scenario compiles but is not runtime-verified yet.

newFindings.title: Built-in Alt, Shift and Snippets accessibility names were English-only; modifier name/state and click semantics could split across nodes
newFindings.rootCause: The renderer localized Ctrl and special keys but left these built-ins as English literals. A semantics review also showed merged parent semantics might not own the clickable action.
newFindings.fix: Added localized labels to all six shipped locales. Modifier keys now set content description, toggle state, role, disabled state, and accessibility onClick on one clearAndSetSemantics node while retaining combinedClickable for touch gesture behavior. Regression test asserts that the named checked UiObject2 is clickable.
newFindings.tests: MarketDebug app compile, AndroidTest Kotlin compile, 1,021/1,021 JVM tests, lint (0 errors), MarketDebug assemble, both source gates, six-locale resource parity PASS; device instrumentation pending.

newFindings.title: Delayed macros could continue on a replacement SSH shell after automatic reconnect
newFindings.rootCause: Cancellation checked only for Closed state. The same SshSession transitions Reconnecting→Connected after auto-reconnect, so a delayed macro could send remaining steps, such as Enter, to a new shell.
newFindings.fix: Added a monotonic channel epoch advanced on shell install/loss/disconnect. Macro dispatcher captures the epoch, cancels on state/epoch change, and gates each synchronous dispatch against the captured live channel under a lock.
newFindings.tests: Deterministic coroutine unit regression changes epoch during a delay and reconnects to Connected before resume; asserts the later Enter is not dispatched. MarketDebug JVM 1,022/1,022; app and AndroidTest compile, lint, assemble and source gates PASS. GitHub CI run 38402910371 queued.

newFindings.title: Import silently discarded toolbar actions unknown to this app version and could replace drafts raced from SAF picker
newFindings.rootCause: Forward-compatible codec decoding intentionally omitted unsupported action bindings without surfacing loss; SAF import candidate was only gated when picker launched, so editor drafts created while external picker/read was active could be overwritten.
newFindings.fix: Count undecodable actions during decode; carry the count through repository preview and show a localized warning in six supported locales. Reuse a pure clean-draft import gate at launch and after bounded file reading before showing candidate.
newFindings.tests: Codec and repository preview assert omitted action count; ToolbarImportPolicy tests clean/dirty profile/pending macro/pending theme; current JVM suite 1,026/1,026 PASS. Runtime SAF picker/callback still requires device verification.

newFindings.title: Named Settings switch omitted check state from its app accessibility node on API 26
newFindings.rootCause: The labeled outer merged semantics node relied on nested toggleable semantics to publish switch role/state; API 26 accessibility bridge did not expose the named node as checkable.
newFindings.fix: Explicitly publish Role.Switch and ToggleableState.On/Off on the labeled merged node while retaining toggleable as the sole physical/accessibility click action. The test still requires the same named node to be checkable and clickable.
newFindings.tests: Local MarketDebug app and AndroidTest Kotlin compilation pass; API26/36 runtime regression awaits new CI. Latest pre-fix source run 38452720047 showed this failure across API26/36 Debug/Preview.

newFindings.title: Concurrent macro executions can interleave terminal input
newFindings.rootCause: ToolbarDispatcher launched every macro independently; delayed sequences could mix text and Enter steps.
newFindings.fix: Added a non-blocking per-dispatcher macro gate; because Compose recreates the dispatcher, the gate is now remembered for the lifetime of the active SSH session and passed into each dispatcher instance.
newFindings.tests: MacroExecutionGateTest deterministically blocks an overlapping run and checks that sequential later run is accepted; part of 1,030/1,030 JVM PASS.

newFindings.title: AWS Secret Access Key assignment escaped credential heuristic
newFindings.rootCause: Generic secret detector expected colon/equal directly after "secret" and missed AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.
newFindings.fix: Added case-insensitive underscore and hyphen AWS secret access key assignment patterns with = or :.
newFindings.tests: MacroCredentialPatternTest covers standard/export assignments and normal aws s3 ls; part of 1,030/1,030 JVM PASS.

newFindings.title: Import preview did not disclose macros that submit commands
newFindings.rootCause: Preview showed macro count but did not identify imported macro definitions containing Enter.
newFindings.fix: Preview counts Enter-bearing macros and shows a localized warning across six supported locales.
newFindings.tests: ToolbarImportPreviewTest asserts positive and zero counts; resource XML parsed; part of 1,030/1,030 JVM PASS.

newFindings.title: Labeled Settings switch lacked checkable state in the API 26 accessibility tree
newFindings.rootCause: CI 38490916105 on API36 Debug showed the named row as android.view.View, checkable=false, clickable=false, with only focus/selection actions; API26/36 SettingsToggle failed across all variants. This confirms an accessibility semantics problem rather than only a flaky test.
newFindings.fix: Replace the ambiguous parent-toggleable/child-Switch merge with clearAndSetSemantics on one full-row Role.Switch node, explicitly providing the label, toggle state, ACTION_CLICK persistence behavior, disabled state while saving, and reset long-click. The existing physical toggleable remains on the row and routes taps to the same SettingsStore.
newFindings.tests: Local MarketDebug app/AndroidTest Kotlin compile PASS; 1,030 JVM tests PASS; lint and MarketDebug assembly PASS; root debug APK signature verified. New explicit semantics still need API26/36 instrumentation runtime evidence.

newFindings.title: Macro overlap guard was replaced during Compose recomposition
newFindings.rootCause: TerminalScreen constructs a fresh ToolbarDispatcher on recomposition; a gate stored only inside the dispatcher would be reset while a delayed macro was still running.
newFindings.fix: Remember the MacroExecutionGate keyed by the active SshSession and inject the stable gate into every newly-created dispatcher for that session.
newFindings.tests: MacroExecutionGateTest remains in the 1,030-test passing JVM suite; current app compile passes once final Gradle completes. Device/runtime recomposition coverage remains pending.
